sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: tekken8hacks.com is a Windows PC store for Tekken 8 Hacks. The cheat is one product with Frame, Heat, Punish, Combo and Stream-proof overlay.
Tekken 8 Hacks is $35 for 30 days or $150 lifetime. Starting on a month does not promise a credit toward lifetime.

Product names on this site identify what we sell. They are not a claim that the game publisher endorses the software. Delivery is a portal download for Windows 10 or 11. You keep HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot on, then open the loader only when the site still matches the current client.

sections.heading: What we publish
paragraphs: The [Tekken 8 Hacks](/product/tekken-8-hack/) page lists the menu names, Windows requirements, and checkout plans: Windows 10 or 11, Intel or AMD, with HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot left on.

The [forum](/forum/) contains example discussions about Tekken 8 features and gameplay, each connected to a blog guide. Read the [terms](/terms/) before checkout. Sales are final, including restrictions.
Check this site after a Tekken 8 client update before you open the loader. If the page is not current for that build, leave the software closed.
The [status page](/status/) shows the PC build and whether the loader is Ready, Updating, or Paused. Check the listed version after a game patch.

sections.heading: Support
paragraphs: Loader errors, a key that will not move, and checkout questions go through the [support page](/support/). Include your order ID from checkout, Windows version, and the exact loader text. Do not turn HVCI, core isolation, TPM, or secure boot off because a chat message from another game said to.

Before opening a ticket, check which product and plan appear on your receipt. A delivery question and a loader error need different information. Include the time the issue started and the exact message you saw. Keep passwords, payment details, and license keys out of public channels.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: We may collect standard web analytics such as page views, device type, browser, and approximate region through Google Analytics when enabled. Checkout and license delivery happen on external checkout pages. We do not store payment card data on tekken8hacks.com.

sections.heading: How we use data
paragraphs: Analytics help us understand which guides and product pages are useful so we can improve content and fix broken links. Support tickets may retain the Discord handle and message content you provide until the issue is resolved.

sections.heading: Cookies

sections.heading: What you purchase
paragraphs: We sell Tekken 8 Hacks for Windows PC. The cheat is $35 for 30 days or $150 lifetime. Each license is delivered through a portal and loader.
Feature lists on the product page describe what is included at the time of purchase. Modules can change when Tekken 8 or Tekken 8 patches updates.

sections.heading: Checkout and delivery
paragraphs: Payment and license delivery run on external checkout pages. tekken8hacks.com does not process or store payment card numbers.
After purchase, use the portal from your order to download the current loader before you launch Tekken 8. Leave HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot on.

sections.heading: License use
paragraphs: Licenses are for your personal use only. Do not share loader files, portal logins, or license keys.

sections.heading: Refunds and purchases
paragraphs: All sales are final once checkout completes. We do not refund change-of-mind purchases or issues caused by ignoring the setup notes or launching while the site is not current for that patch.

If the product does not work as described on a supported setup—Windows 10 or 11 with HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot on, and the current loader from the portal—contact us through the Support page. Include your order ID from checkout Windows version, and the exact loader text.
We may, at our discretion, offer a fix, replacement access, or partial/full refund when we confirm a fault on our side. We are not obligated to approve every request.

sections.heading: Availability and risk
paragraphs: Third-party tools for Tekken 8 can conflict with game updates. You use this software at your own risk.
Check the homepage status banner before every session. Do not launch Tekken 8 while modules are offline or misaligned after a patch.
